errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

noPermission.title: No permission
noPermission.body: You don't have permission to view this.

consumer.invalid-code: That code isn't a valid slug. Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, 2-63 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
consumer.duplicate-code: A consuming party with this code already exists.
consumer.schema-not-allowed: This consuming party isn't allowed to consume credentials of this schema — its allowlist is deny-by-default. Add the schema to the party's allowlist first.

rbc.api_key_invalid: This API key is invalid, unknown, or the consuming party has been suspended.

issue.title: Issue Credential
issue.pickPrompt: Select a published schema to issue against.
issue.noSchemas: No published schemas are available to issue against.
issue.holderRefHelp: A pseudonymous holder identifier from your system (pseudo_ref).
issue.maxUsesHelp: How many times this credential may be consumed (optional).
issue.validMinutesHelp: How long the credential stays valid (optional).
issue.unknownTypeWarning: Unknown field type "{{type}}" for "{{field}}"; rendered as text.
issue.refHelp: The credential's permanent identifier (its UUID id).
issue.claimCodeHelp: Single-use: hand this to the wallet holder so they can redeem the credential.
issue.codeShownOnce: This claim code is shown once. Copy it or scan the QR now; the platform cannot reveal it again.
issue.qrLocalhostHint: This QR embeds a localhost address and will not work when scanned from a phone — set VITE_QR_API_BASE to your machine's LAN IP.

verify.title: Verify Credential
verify.prompt: Paste an SD-JWT presentation to verify it.
verify.sdJwtPlaceholder: compact SD-JWT (~ separated) or a bare compact JWT — end with a trailing ~ if there's no key-binding JWT
verify.blank: Paste a presentation to see the verification result.
verify.noClaims: No claims were disclosed in this presentation.

revoke.title: Revoke Credential
revoke.lookupHelp: The credential's UUID id (not its human-facing reference).
revoke.confirmBody: Revocation is permanent and irreversible. The credential will fail every future verification and consumption.
revoke.confirmTypePrompt: Type the credential ID to confirm:
revoke.confirmMismatch: The ID you typed does not match.

publishConfirm.title: Publish this schema?
publishConfirm.body: After publishing, its claim fields can never change again. Any future correction requires a new version. This action cannot be undone.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive this schema?
archiveConfirm.body: Archiving stops new issuance against this schema only. Every credential already issued against it — and its verification and consumption — is completely unaffected.

builder.codeHelp: Immutable once created — cannot be changed later.
builder.nameRequired: Both English and Arabic names are required
builder.labelRequired: Both English and Arabic labels are required
builder.atLeastOneField: At least one claim field is required

consumingParties.title: Consuming Parties
consumingParties.noAllowedSchemas: None — this party can consume nothing (deny-by-default).

create.title: Register consuming party
create.codeHelp: A lowercase slug (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), 2-63 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Immutable once created.
create.codeInvalid: Use a lowercase slug (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), 2 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
create.nameRequired: Both English and Arabic names are required

suspendConfirm.title: Suspend this consuming party?
suspendConfirm.body: Its API keys stop authenticating immediately — the same outcome as revoking them. You can reactivate the party at any time.

activateConfirm.title: Reactivate this consuming party?
activateConfirm.body: Its API keys will authenticate again.

allowlist.title: Allowlist — {{code}}
allowlist.help: Deny-by-default: this party can only consume credentials of schemas checked below.

mintConfirm.title: Mint a new API key?
mintConfirm.body: The key is shown exactly once and cannot be retrieved again. Any previously minted keys for this party remain valid until individually revoked.

mint.shownOnce: This key is shown once. Copy it now; the platform cannot reveal it again.

issueBulk.title: Bulk Issue Credentials
issueBulk.templateHelp: Download a CSV template for this schema, fill it in, then upload it in the next step.

upload.noRows: No data rows were found in this file.
upload.tooManyRows: This file has more than {{max}} rows. Split it into smaller batches and upload separately.

preview.claimCodesShownOnce: Claim codes are shown once, in the report after issuing. Export the report before leaving that page — the platform cannot reveal them again.

report.claimCodesWarning: These claim codes are shown once. Export this report now — leaving this page loses them forever.

consumeSim.title: Consume Simulator
consumeSim.banner: Testing/demo tool: this simulates a consuming party's own consume call, authenticated with a pasted API key. It is not a production consumption channel.

form.apiKeyHelp: Pasted key lives only in this page's memory — never stored, logged, or put in the URL. Cleared when you navigate away.
form.idempotencyKeyHelp: Re-sending the same key demonstrates idempotent replay — the platform returns the first outcome without consuming again.

result.reasonIdempotentReplay: Idempotent replay — same outcome as the first call
